decisions.reason: The track spotlight line is close to the core offer, still has its own page after two years, and shows no shortfall against aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The flexible spotlight line is new, close to the core offer and prominently presented, and slack allows the firm to give it time before judging it against aspirations.
The multi-outlet canopy complements the modular systems and supports sales of existing luminaires, so its results are likely judged as adequate.
The low-voltage canopy extends the system offer at low cost, and with no evidence of a shortfall the firm keeps it while its results are still uncertain.

The glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which signals weaker visibility, but they are close to the core and too new to have shown a clear shortfall, so slack allows another year.
